title: Late Fees and Returned-Payment Fees - Larkspur Credit Cards Cardmember Terms
content:
These cardmember terms set when the Larkspur Credit Cards charge a late fee or a returned-payment fee, and how much.

## The fee clause

1. **Late fee.** A late fee posts when the minimum payment is not received by the payment due date. It is the card's first late fee amount, or the card's repeat late fee amount when another late fee posted in the six previous billing cycles. It is never more than the minimum payment due.
2. **Returned-payment fee.** A returned-payment fee follows the same first and repeat amounts and cap. It is charged for return codes R01, R02, R03, R04, R08, R09, R16 and R20 only.
3. **One fee per event.** Only one penalty fee is charged for a single event: when a returned payment also makes the payment late, either the late fee or the returned-payment fee posts, not both, and any second fee is reversed as a single penalty event.
4. **One late fee per due date.** One late fee at most posts per payment due date.

## Definitions used in the clause

- **"Another late fee posted in the six previous billing cycles."** This looks at the six billing cycles before the cycle of the new fee. It counts the late fees on the same card account in that window that have not been reversed. One or more such fees means the repeat amount; none means the first amount.
- **Returned-payment fees** use the same window, counting the account's returned-payment fees that have not been reversed.
- **The cap.** The amount is compared with the minimum payment due, and the lower of the two is charged.
- **Evidence.** All of these are read from the account's own posted entries, before the fee posts:
  - the kind of each entry;
  - the payment due date a late fee belongs to;
  - the payment or return line an entry is tied to.

## Input, judgement, output: the late fee amount

| Earlier late fees (not reversed) in the six previous cycles | Applicable amount | Charged |
|---|---|---|
| None | the first late fee amount | the lower of that amount and the minimum payment due |
| One or more | the repeat late fee amount | the lower of that amount and the minimum payment due |

## Returned payments by return code

| Return code of the returned payment | Returned-payment fee? |
|---|---|
| R01, R02, R03, R04, R08, R09, R16 or R20 | Yes, at the first or repeat amount, capped at the minimum payment due |
| Any other code | No |

## Worked case on invented amounts

The fee amounts and the minimum payment here are hypothetical, not any card's terms. Assume a first amount of 20.00, a repeat amount of 30.00 and a minimum payment due of 25.00.

- **No unreversed late fee in the six previous cycles.** The applicable amount is 20.00, which is below 25.00, so the fee is 20.00.
- **One unreversed late fee in that window.** The applicable amount is 30.00, which is above 25.00, so the fee is capped at 25.00.
- **An earlier late fee in that window that was reversed.** It is not counted, so the first amount, 20.00, applies.
- **A payment due date that already has a late fee.** No second late fee posts for it.
- **A payment returned with code R01 that also leaves the due date unpaid.** Only one penalty fee stands for that event. Any second fee is reversed as a single penalty event.
